## 🧠 Concept Comment (Required - 2 Sentences)
 
1. We used a feature branch to keep `main` stable while developing the portfolio. This allows us to review and test our changes before merging them into the main branch.
2. We checked the existing project files before applying our changes to avoid overwriting unrelated work. Since there were no overlapping edits, we did not need to resolve any merge conflicts.
